notes.title: Public Demo available from September 22nd 10:00 (UTC)!!
notes.content: [p]I'm happy to announce that a public demo will be available starting Monday, [b]September 22nd 10:00 (UTC)!![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This is a key milestone in the game's development, and we are looking forward to collect your feedback. We want this game to an enjoying game.[/p][p][/p][p]The demo is available on PC with Windows 10 or above.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Discord Server[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Discord server will be added later for all users to give feedback and share there builds. Some feedbacks will be directly answered by devs.[/p][p][/p][p]Future Games will be announced first by Discord so please join![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1][b]Demo 0.7.0 is Released!!!![/b][/h1][hr][/hr]
